name: LibHoughTransform
summary: This is a library implementing the Linear Hough Transform for feature extraction from 2D image data. It provides a factory function to create Hough transform objects that detect straight lines in binary images and return line parameters (slope and intercept). The library is designed as a reusable component for pattern recognition tasks, not as a standalone trading EA.
summary_zh: 这是一个实现线性霍夫变换的库，用于从二维图像数据中提取特征。它提供工厂函数创建霍夫变换对象，检测二值图像中的直线并返回直线参数（斜率和截距）。该库设计为可复用的模式识别组件，而非独立的交易EA。
strategy_analysis: 该代码并非交易策略，而是一个霍夫变换数学库，用于图像处理中的直线检测。霍夫变换的核心概念是将图像空间中的点映射到参数空间，通过投票机制找到共线的点集。入场条件在此不适用，因为库函数接收HoughImage输入并遍历所有非零像素进行参数空间累积。出场条件同样不适用，但提取过程中使用findMax函数依次找出投票数最高的参数点，并对峰值邻域清零以避免重复检测。仓位管理和资金管理完全不涉及。该库支持int和double两种数据类型模板实例化，通过createHoughTransform工厂函数创建对象，最多可提取8条直线的参数。参数空间将0到π的角度范围量化为size个离散值，距离范围根据图像对角线长度自动计算。
strategy_analysis_en: This code is not a trading strategy but a Hough Transform mathematical library for line detection in image processing. The core concept of the Hough Transform maps points from image space to parameter space, finding collinear point sets through a voting mechanism. Entry conditions are not applicable here, as the library function accepts a HoughImage input and iterates over all non-zero pixels to accumulate votes in parameter space. Exit conditions are likewise not applicable, but the extraction process uses the findMax function to sequentially find the parameter points with the highest vote counts, zeroing out the peak neighborhood to avoid duplicate detections. Position sizing and money management are completely absent as this is a utility library. The library supports template instantiation with int and double data types, creates objects via the createHoughTransform factory function, and can extract parameters for up to 8 lines. The parameter space quantizes the angle range from 0 to π into size discrete values, with the distance range automatically calculated based on the image diagonal length.

parameters.name: quants
parameters.description: 参数空间量化精度，决定角度和距离的离散化数量
parameters.description_en: Quantization parameter for Hough transform angle and distance resolution

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description_en: Number of detected lines; 2 parameters per line

pros: 采用模板化设计，支持多种数据类型复用，代码通用性强
工厂模式创建对象，解耦了接口与实现，便于扩展更多变换类型
预计算三角函数值存储在查找表中，避免重复计算，提高运行效率
峰值邻域清零机制有效防止同一直线被重复检测
提供了getHoughInfo元信息函数，便于库的使用者了解输出参数含义
pros_en: Template-based design supports multiple data types for reuse, providing strong code generality
Factory pattern for object creation decouples interface from implementation, facilitating extension of more transform types
Pre-computed trigonometric values stored in a lookup table avoid redundant calculations, improving runtime efficiency
Peak neighborhood zeroing mechanism effectively prevents duplicate detection of the same line
Provides getHoughInfo meta-information function for library users to understand output parameter meanings
cons: findMax函数每次线性扫描整个参数空间，时间复杂度O(n²)，对大尺寸量化参数效率低下
缺乏对输入图像尺寸和quants参数的边界校验，可能导致数组越界或内存溢出
当MathSin(y*d)接近零时未做充分的数值稳定性处理，可能产生极大或不准确的参数值
仅实现线性霍夫变换，不支持圆检测或其他形状检测，功能单一
extract函数中i的循环变量在提前返回和continue时可能导致计数错误
cons_en: findMax function performs linear scan of the entire parameter space each time, O(n²) complexity, inefficient for large quantization sizes
Lacks boundary validation for input image dimensions and quants parameter, potentially causing array out-of-bounds or memory overflow
Insufficient numerical stability handling when MathSin(y*d) approaches zero, potentially producing extremely large or inaccurate parameter values
Only implements linear Hough Transform without support for circle detection or other shape detection, limited functionality
The loop variable i in extract function may cause counting errors when early returns and continue statements interact
improvements: 优化findMax为维护有序结构或使用更高效的峰值检测算法，降低多次提取的时间复杂度
增加输入参数校验和异常处理，包括quants范围检查、图像尺寸验证及除零保护
支持更多霍夫变换变体（如圆形检测、广义霍夫变换），增强库的适用范围
improvements_en: Optimize findMax to maintain an ordered structure or use more efficient peak detection algorithms to reduce time complexity for multiple extractions
Add input parameter validation and exception handling, including quants range checks, image dimension verification, and divide-by-zero protection
Support more Hough Transform variants such as circle detection and generalized Hough Transform to broaden the library's applicability

risk_points: 该库不涉及交易操作，无资金风险
数值计算中存在除零和溢出隐患，可能在极端输入下产生无效结果
risk_points_en: This library does not involve trading operations, no financial risk
